explain.say: A side is a straight edge. Count the sides of a triangle: 1, 2, 3. Every shape with 3 straight sides is a triangle, like a samosa or a road warning sign. Can you draw one in the air?

explain.say: Some shapes have more sides. A pentagon has 5, a hexagon has 6, like a honeycomb cell, and a stop sign has 8. Count the corners too: a shape has as many corners as sides! Can you check that with a triangle?

faq.q: What makes a shape a triangle?
faq.a: A triangle is a flat shape with exactly 3 straight sides and 3 corners. The sides can be different lengths, but there are always 3.
asks: How many sides does a triangle have?

faq.q: What is the difference between a square and a rectangle?
faq.a: Both have 4 straight sides and 4 square corners. A square has all 4 sides the same length, while a rectangle has 2 longer and 2 shorter sides. A square is a special rectangle.
A hexagon is a flat shape with 6 straight sides and 6 corners. The cells in a honeycomb are hexagons.
asks: How many sides does a hexagon have?

faq.a: A circle has no straight sides and no corners. It has one curved edge that goes all the way round.
asks: How many sides does a circle have?

faq.a: A 2D shape is flat, like a drawing on paper. It has length and width but no thickness, so you cannot pick it up like a box.

facts: A flat shape with straight sides has the same number of corners as sides.
In most countries, a stop sign is an octagon, with 8 sides.
